channel.description: Events newly added to the calendar, most recent first.

item.title: Home Away from Home: Student Life on Campus — Wed Jul 29, 9:00 AM — HERMAN B WELLS LIBRARY
item.description:
Spanning across four decades—1970s to the 2000s—items including scrapbooks, photographs, student papers, and handbooks demonstrate life on and off campus. From decorating dorm rooms to chasing campus ghosts, students have always found ways to build community and make new memories. This exhibit highlights the student experience and the multitude of ways students found a sense of home, identity and belonging at Indiana University.
Source: IU Bloomington Libraries

item.title: National Wing Day at BuffaLouie's – Benefits Riley Children's Foundation — Wed Jul 29, 10:30 AM — BuffaLouie's at The Gables
item.description:
National Wing Day (July 29) at BuffaLouie's in Bloomington. As part of the "Eat Wings. Give Back." campaign, BuffaLouie's will donate $1 for every bone-in wing sold to Riley Children's Foundation, supporting families served by Riley Hospital for Children. Same fundraiser also runs at the Carmel location.Source: Herald-Times/Evening World, "Taking BuffaLouie's to the next level, and helping others along the way," July 28, 2026.More info: buffalouies.com
Source: BloomingtonOnline Food & Drink

item.title: New Exhibitions at the Brown County Art Guild! — Wed Jul 29, 3:00 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description:
July 24 – November 7, 2026 Guild Artist Exhibition and Sale
Summer brings fresh inspiration, and our Guild Artists have been busy creating new work to share. Discover new landscapes, still lifes, contemporary works, and more as you explore the Guild Galleries. Whether you’re an avid collector, art enthusiast, or simply looking for inspiration, this exhibition offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the creativity that continues to thrive in Brown County.
July 24 – November 7, 2026 The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views Special Exhibition & Sale
The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views is a special exhibition and sale that celebrates the familiar vistas, treasured locations, and fresh perspectives that honor both the natural beauty and rich artistic heritage of the area. Find the places you love reflected in original works by the artists of the Brown County Art Guild. Every painting tells a story of Brown County & Nashville, Indiana with color, light and texture. ———————————

item.title: Fresh Air Fridays: Board & Brush DIY Woodcrafting Workshop — Fri Jul 31, 5:00 PM — Oliver Winery
item.description: Uncork your creativity at Oliver Winery during a hands-on woodworking workshop led by Nicole DeGain, co-owner of Bloomington’s Board & Brush studio. Nicole will guide guests through the process of creating a rustic, wood-crafted project while sharing simple woodworking techniques, creative tips, and step-by-step instruction. No prior experience is needed, and all tools and materials are provided. Your ticket includes the guided workshop, all project materials, and one complimentary glass of wine for guests 21\+. Non-alcoholic beverages are also available, and additional wine may be purchased by the glass or bottle throughout the evening. At the end of the workshop, you'll leave with a finished handmade project and new skills to take home. Whether you're planning a night out with friends, a date night, or simply looking to try something new, this event offers the perfect blend of creativity, relaxation, and great wine. item.title: Saturday Crafternoons: Printing with Plants — Sat Aug 1, 11:00 AM — Wylie House Museum
item.description:
Printing with Plants! Explore anthotypes, cyanotypes, and plant-based dye by creating your own art pieces using plants and flowers from the Wylie House garden.
Saturday Crafternoons are a free event for families, students, and friends of all ages! Activities change monthly.
The Wylie House Museum is open 10am-4pm, Fridays and Saturdays, except holidays. Free guided tours are offered on the hour, every hour with the last tour at 3pm. Check the Wylie House Museum socials and website for updated information, parking, and museum hours.
Source: BloomingtonOnline Events

item.title: Lotus Lantern Workshop — Fri Aug 7, 5:30 PM — Lotus Firebay
item.description:
Help bring the Lotus Festival to life by creating a flower that will bloom under the night sky! Join us for a free, hands-on workshop where you’ll craft cardboard flower petals and help build our towering 11-foot illuminated flower lanterns. Cut your own unique petals or choose from pre-cut designs, then add your creativity to a one-of-a-kind community art installation that will glow throughout the evenings of the Lotus World Music & Arts Festival. Every participant will be recognized in the official Lotus Festival Program, and when the festival arrives, you’ll be able to point to the lanterns and say, “I helped create that.” This workshop is free and open to all ages and skill levels. Donations are appreciated and will help us purchase materials to bring these giant blooms to life. RSVP today or stop by Friday August 7th! Email KP at associatedirector@lotusfest.org for any questions.
Source: Lotus Festival
